scope: Cross-year pedagogical progression and evidence-coverage audit for Recovery Curriculum v2. This is not the definitive technical gap-analysis.json.

coverage_definitions.covered: Existing validated content provides the required primary-axis evidence shape plus enough unseen/mixed cumulative transfer potential to satisfy the outcome when selected by the learner programme.
coverage_definitions.partially_covered: Existing content provides meaningful prerequisite, controlled-performance or topic-level transfer evidence, but one or more required primary-axis, breadth or cumulative-transfer evidence families are absent.
coverage_definitions.missing: No existing Recovery content provides sufficient primary-axis evidence for the observable performance; incidental grammar context or prerequisite support is not counted as outcome coverage.

methodology.weighted_coverage_formula: covered = 1.0; partially_covered = 0.5; missing = 0.0. Weighted coverage is a planning indicator, not a readiness score.
methodology.critical_year_exit_rule: topic_verify is supporting evidence only. assessment-blueprint.json sets can_satisfy_year_exit_alone=false, so no outcome is classified covered solely from a four-phase topic bundle or Verification v2.
methodology.topic_audit_evidence_ceiling: Recover provides knowledge/scaffolding, Practice controlled performance, School topic-scoped school-format transfer, Verify topic-level transfer. None independently supplies cumulative year-exit transfer.
methodology.readiness_policy_compatibility: Read-only compatibility check performed after readiness-policy.json merged: topic_verify remains supporting evidence; required blocking outcomes require cumulative transfer evidence; inactive programme-dependent axes do not lower readiness. No readiness policy fields were modified by this audit.

headline_findings: The existing 24 topic bundles form a strong grammar recovery layer but do not yet constitute a complete year-exit curriculum evidence system.

The main P0 blocker is not another large wave of isolated grammar worksheets: it is the absence of approved cumulative unseen assessment fragments plus core reading, lexical and Year 1 connected-writing content.

Year 2 currently contains several outcomes with no Year 1 prerequisite links even though their observable performance is explicitly a consolidation/extension; these links should be added during integration.
Year 3 progression is structurally stronger, but several B1 core grammar outcomes depend on planned Wave 3 topics, while all B1 reading/lexical/writing transfer needs dedicated content families.
Listening and functional communication remain correctly conditional and should not become universal readiness blockers.

cross_year_prerequisite_recommendations.rationale: Year 2 integrated tense transfer presupposes Year 1 control of present contrast, finished past and basic future choice; currently it restarts with no v2 outcome dependency.
Auxiliary, question, negative and word-order control is a direct progression from the Year 1 basic sentence outcome.
Meaning-based modals extend Year 1 modal control; zero/first conditional also relies on established present/future meaning.
Reference, pronouns and prepositional/descriptive control should precede relative-clause and sentence-expansion work.
Year 2 nominal/quantity/comparison transfer is consolidation and extension of Year 1 noun-phrase and comparison control.
The Year 2 broad lexical profile explicitly consolidates the major Year 1 domain families rather than starting a new lexicon.
Connected A2 Year 2 reading should build on Year 1 short descriptive/narrative text comprehension.
Contextual inference and reference tracking are explicit extensions of the Year 1 context/reference outcome.
Year 2 functional email/message production is a direct progression from the Year 1 A2 message/email outcome.
Year 2 narration with background actions extends the Year 1 simple completed-event narrative.
Organised description/explanation should build on basic connected descriptive paragraph production.
The Year 2 profile assumes the learner can already follow short A2 dialogue/monologue input before increasing naturalness and breadth.
Requests, offers, permission and practical exchanges directly extend the corresponding Year 1 functional outcome.
Experiences/plans with reasons extend Year 1 experience/plan communication rather than restarting the communicative chain.
Reported speech requires tense/reference control and sentence linking in addition to the already-declared question/negative sentence control.
Independent error revision presupposes established auxiliary, question, negative and word-order control.
B1 lexical breadth/collocation use should depend on Year 2 contextual lexical selection; avoid depending on optional RY2-LEX-003.
B1 explanation/opinion with reasons extends Year 2 organised description/explanation.
Revision of clarity/cohesion is meaningful only after the learner can produce the connected B1 text being revised.
B1 listening should build on Year 2 detail/sequence/simple-inference control; RY2-LISTEN-001 alone is too low a bridge.

findings: No default_core outcome currently depends on a programme_dependent functional/oral outcome.
Listening remains default_if_assessed and functional_communication remains programme_dependent across the progression, so those axes are not automatically forced into every recovery profile.
The proposed prerequisite additions intentionally avoid making a default_core outcome depend on a prior-year default_if_assessed/programme_dependent outcome.
RY3-READ-001 is not recommended to depend on RY2-READ-003 because RY2-READ-003 is default_if_assessed while RY3-READ-001 is default_core.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Be, have got, there is/are
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Required by RY1-GRAM-001; basic sentence control cannot be fully supported without be/have got/there is-are.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Adverbs of frequency
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Recommended across Year 1 routine/lexical control and Year 2 sentence control; legacy tier is core, but no current default-core outcome makes the separate topic a hard prerequisite.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Past Simple vs Past Continuous
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Required by RY3-GRAM-001 and central to Year 2 narrative transfer.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Present Perfect: ever/never, just/already/yet, for/since
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Required by RY3-GRAM-003 and supports mature Year 2/3 Present Perfect choice.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Gerund and infinitive
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Supports sentence expansion/revision but is only recommended, not required, by current v2 core outcomes.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Somebody / anything / nobody / everywhere...
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Useful noun/reference extension; currently recommended rather than required.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Too / enough
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Useful for comparison/description and revision, but not required by a current core outcome.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Used to
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Required by core RY3-GRAM-001 for past habits/states.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Present Perfect Continuous
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Programme-dependent B1+ extension; only recommended by RY3-GRAM-003.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Past Perfect and narrative tenses
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Required only by programme-dependent RY3-GRAM-002; also supports advanced narration.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Question tags
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Present in the legacy catalogue but no current v2 outcome requires or recommends it; build only when a declared school programme needs it.

missing_grammar_topics.label: Wish / if only
missing_grammar_topics.rationale: Programme-dependent B1+ extension recommended by RY3-GRAM-004.

missing_content_families.need: Approved unseen/transformed fragments tagged by primary axis, outcome_ids, mode, school task family, duration and difficulty so checkpoints and mocks can collect disaggregated transfer evidence.
missing_content_families.why: Without this pool, topic_verify remains supporting evidence and no outcome can be fully covered at year-exit level.

missing_content_families.need: Fresh mixed grammar, sentence building, transformation and plausible error-correction fragments where the target rule is not announced.
missing_content_families.why: Current School/Verify phases are still scoped to a known topic and therefore cannot alone prove autonomous system selection across topics.

missing_content_families.affected_outcome_scope: grammar plus lexical/writing-supporting outcomes that declare translation_it_en
missing_content_families.need: Cumulative Italian→English fragments mixing previously learned systems, with complete accepted natural variants and increasing sentence/discourse load.
missing_content_families.why: Existing translations are useful but topic-scoped; they do not yet test cross-topic choice or year-level interference patterns.

missing_content_families.need: Year-banded lexical sets embedded in context across school/daily life, relationships, travel, technology, health, environment and work/future, including chunks, common collocations and contextual choice.
missing_content_families.why: Current vocabulary is incidental to grammar prompts and is not scored as lexical competence.

missing_content_families.need: Contextual collocation work, word-family selection where programme-appropriate, anti-calque tasks and paraphrase/precision evidence.
missing_content_families.why: B1 lexical outcomes explicitly require precision and reformulation that the grammar bundles do not teach or assess.

missing_content_families.need: Year 1 functional/short personal texts; Year 2 longer connected texts with gist/detail/sequence/simple inference/context; Year 3 multiparagraph B1 texts with cohesion, attitude, comparison and synthesis.
missing_content_families.why: No current Recovery bundle has reading_comprehension as a dedicated primary-axis evidence source.

missing_content_families.need: Personal/descriptive paragraph, short message/email and simple narrative tasks with guided-to-independent progression and explicit task/organisation/language evidence.
missing_content_families.why: Year 1 writing is default_core; sentence-level translation or grammar production cannot establish connected writing competence.

missing_content_families.need: Reusable fresh forms for mixed grammar, open cloze, transformations, error correction, IT→EN, sentence production, reading text, functional text and writing, mapped to outcomes/axes.
missing_content_families.why: Modalità scuola exists per topic, but cumulative school evidence needs cross-topic/outcome fragments and format breadth.

missing_content_families.need: Email/message, narration, description/explanation, opinion/reasons and B1 revision tasks with independent-writing rubrics.
missing_content_families.why: These outcomes are default_if_assessed but are essential for a robust school profile when writing is part of the recovery test.

missing_content_families.need: Own-text revision and plausible-error editing that distinguishes grammar correction from improving cohesion, reference, lexical choice and organisation.
missing_content_families.why: Current error correction acts on supplied sentences, not on revision of connected learner writing.

missing_content_families.affected_outcome_scope: RY2-READ-003, RY3-READ-003 and upper-year writing outcomes
missing_content_families.need: Short integrated tasks requiring selection/synthesis of source information before a concise written response.
missing_content_families.why: The curriculum asks for selecting and combining distributed information, which isolated grammar items cannot show.

missing_content_families.need: Year 1 short dialogues/monologues; Year 2 more natural detail/inference tasks; Year 3 B1 longer multi-turn and multi-speaker audio, always without transcript-first support.
missing_content_families.why: No current Recovery topic bundle provides audio-backed listening evidence; the axis is conditional on the school programme.

missing_content_families.affected_outcome_scope: all 9 functional communication outcomes when required
missing_content_families.need: Practical exchanges, responsive follow-ups, clarification requests, repair/reformulation and non-memorised multi-turn interaction in written/spoken form as appropriate.
missing_content_families.why: Current functional contexts are largely grammar-scoped and cannot demonstrate adaptive interaction.

missing_content_families.affected_outcome_scope: programme-dependent Year 3 grammar outcomes and school-specific overrides
missing_content_families.need: Past Perfect/narrative tenses, Reported Speech and selected B1+ extensions only when the official school programme requires them.
missing_content_families.why: These should not delay a core first release for students whose school programme does not assess them.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Cross-year prerequisite alignment
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Review and apply the prerequisite recommendations to Year 2/3 outcome files in the later integration PR; no content authoring in this audit.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: Prevents Year 2 from appearing to restart at zero and makes Year 3 dependency chains explicit before readiness consumes them.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Core missing grammar systems
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Build be/have got/there is-are, past simple vs past continuous, Present Perfect time expressions, zero/first conditional, second conditional, relative clauses, used to and passive voice.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: These are required by default-core outcomes and currently block complete language-system evidence.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Cumulative transfer foundation
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Create approved assessment fragments for mixed grammar, IT→EN, sentence production, transformation and error correction with unseen/transformed forms and outcome/axis metadata.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: This is the main architectural pedagogical blocker: without cumulative transfer fragments, no existing topic can become full year-exit evidence.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Core lexical + reading progression
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Build Year 1-3 lexical domain/chunk progression and primary-axis reading sets at A1+/A2, A2+/early B1 and B1/B1+.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: Lexical and reading are core axes but current Recovery content is grammar-primary.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Year 1 connected writing
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Build paragraph, email/message and simple narrative progression with guided and independent evidence.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: Year 1 writing outcomes are default_core and currently lack connected production.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Upper-year writing, lexical depth and integrated tasks
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Build Year 2/3 writing, self-editing, collocation/word-family/paraphrase and integrated reading-to-writing fragments.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: Raises the product from grammar recovery to robust A2+/B1 school competence where those formats are assessed.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Listening + functional communication
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Build year-banded listening and adaptive practical interaction/clarification/repair content, activated only by programme profile.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: Important when assessed, but must remain optional rather than delaying grammar/written core for all learners.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Programme-dependent Year 3 grammar
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Build Past Perfect/narrative tenses, Reported Speech and selected modal/conditional B1+ extensions according to actual school demand.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: Useful library depth without inflating the default Year 3 profile toward B2.

recommended_implementation_batches.name: Definitive gap analysis
recommended_implementation_batches.deliverable: Merge this pedagogical audit with the separate technical/runtime audit and approved readiness policy into gap-analysis.json.
recommended_implementation_batches.rationale: The definitive plan should only be created when pedagogical need, runtime feasibility and readiness evidence rules are aligned.
